title: M/s Rajendra Engineering Udyog Pvt. Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Pritinker Diwaker, J. and Saral Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed for want of prosecution; interim vacated.
headnote: Writ challenging a demand notice for additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, dismissed for want of prosecution; the 2009 interim restraint on further demand stands vacated.
facts: The petitioner, an industrial consumer, challenged a 1 October 2009 demand notice of Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. seeking additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 7 December 2009 the Court listed the writ with similar 2009 matters and, following an interim order in Writ Petition No. 30582 of 2009, restrained further demand of additional security. On 19 November 2018, none appearing for the petitioner even on the revised list, the writ was dismissed for want of prosecution and the interim order vacated.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging the additional-security demand was dismissed for want of prosecution and the 2009 interim restraint vacated, without any determination of paragraph 4.20.

not_decided.point: Validity of the 1.10.2009 additional-security demand under paragraph 4.20 of the Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: Listed with similar 2009 matters and later dismissed for want of prosecution; the demand was not examined on merits.
